function wrapObject<T extends {name: string} & {id: number}>(value: T): T[] { return [value]; }
function wrapEmpty<T extends {} & {}>(value: T): {value: T} { return {value}; }

const objects = wrapObject({name: 'first', id: 1});
const primitive = wrapEmpty('second');
const first: 'first' = objects[0].name;
const second: 'second' = primitive.value;
